newsitem.title: FRANCE: Rhone head wants 20 pct EPS rise in 97/98.
newsitem.headline: Rhone head wants 20 pct EPS rise in 97/98.

text.p: Rhone-Poulenc chairman Jean-Rene Fourtou on Monday reiterated his previously stated goal of 20 percent growth in net earnings per share for 1997 and expanded the target to include 1998.
"I believe we can maintain a target of 20 percent for net earnings per share in 1997 and 1998, barring exceptional items," Fourtou told Le Figaro daily in an interview.
"With this kind of growth, the group will move towards the average return on capital employed of 13.5 percent which we have set as a target for the end of the century, he said.
Fourtou said on January 30 the chemicals group wold seek 20 percent earnings per share before exceptionals in 1997.
Rhone-Poulenc reported a 25.8 percent rise in net earnings per share for 1996.
